title: Hospital Opening Charge — Rate and Day Count Clauses, Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations
content:
**Clauses governing the hospital opening charge (Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations).**

(a) The hospital opening charge is the hospital opening entry's charged days times the hospital opening daily charge, rounded half up to the cent once on the total.

(b) The hospital opening entry is the opening resident-private entry of a Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed hold that carries more than one resident-private entry: the resident-private entry beginning on the reservation's recorded first privately held day. A reservation carries one resident-private entry per service month, so the hospital opening entry is a single entry, its days as booked counted net of any of them reversed against it.

(c) The hospital opening daily charge is the schedule daily rate for the tier of the room held, the prior schedule pricing the entry's days dated before the current schedule's schedule date and the current schedule the rest. The prior and current schedule rates of each room tier that price the hospital opening charge are the figures this schedule restates from the private pay schedule, the current schedule taking effect on its schedule date, 2026-07-01.

| Tier of the room held | Prior schedule daily rate (days dated before 2026-07-01), USD | Current schedule daily rate (2026-07-01 onward), USD |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

(d) The current-schedule days are the calendar days from 2026-07-01 through the entry's last day, never more than the entry's days and none where the entry ends before 2026-07-01; every other day of the entry is a prior-schedule day.

(e) The hospital opening entry's charged days are its days less any of them held before the transfer notice was delivered, those days being the entry's days dated before the delivery date, or all of its days where no transfer notice is on file. A transfer notice counts from the earlier of its latest delivery to the resident and its latest delivery to the representative; where it has been delivered to only one of them, that delivery is the one counted.

(f) The figures are combined in this order: each schedule rate is first taken to the applicable percent, any per-day credit is then subtracted from that reduced rate, and each resulting daily charge is multiplied by the charged days it applies to; the days not charged at the start of the entry are its first days — where days at the start go uncharged on more than one ground, as many as the larger of the counts on each ground, never their total — the days not charged at the end of the entry are its last days, and the current-schedule days are counted back from the entry's last day; the charge is the sum, rounded half up to the cent once on the total.

| Hypothetical entry | Notice delivered | Uncharged at start | Charged | Current-schedule days | Prior-schedule charged days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12–30 June, 19 days | 14 June | 2 | 17 | 0 | 17 |
| 17–31 July, 15 days | 16 July | 0 | 15 | 15 | 0 |
| 22–30 June, 9 days | none on file | 9 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

For the first row in a Private Secure Memory Care Room: 17 days at 449.00, a charge of 7,633.00; for the second row in the same room: 15 days at 465.00, a charge of 6,975.00.
